nodes.label: AI Export Technical Series and Density Contract
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 resolves correctness risks by keeping technical series homogeneous and observed-only while preserving the current public payload without truncation. Validation covered all 27 Asset/Broker/Portfolio × 3M/6M/1Y × Compact/Standard/Full cases; the public catalog remains at 16 analyses pending deterministic Risk drawdown data.

nodes.label: Homogeneous Technical and Financial Series Boundary
nodes.rationale: Asset, Portfolio, and Broker indicators use homogeneous native-market prices, while snapshots and valuations remain target-currency financial resources. Mixed-currency series may remain for non-technical consumers with an explicit error, but signal calculation receives an empty series so indicators are unavailable rather than invalid.

nodes.label: Unique Asset Technical Universe
nodes.rationale: Portfolio and Broker position legs remain broker-aware financial records, but prices, signals, events, and breadth execute once per unique asset_id. Gross exposure is summed across every broker leg for an asset before weight normalization, preventing duplicate technical work and distorted breadth.

nodes.label: Inter-Bucket Return Anchors
nodes.rationale: Price and FX returns compare each non-empty bucket close to the previous non-empty close; the first populated bucket is null without a deterministic pre-period observation. Portfolio and Broker period return derives from cumulative TWRR, while P&L and external flow derive from Portfolio Engine fields; internal first/last values are descriptive only.

nodes.label: Observed-Only Annotation Semantics
nodes.rationale: Crossings use absolute and relative epsilon 1e-12 with max(abs_epsilon, rel_epsilon * max(abs(left), abs(right))). Carry-forward days cannot emit events; represented gaps do not reset a real Friday-to-Monday transition, unrepresented gaps do reset it, and FX carry-forward observations are excluded from returns and volatility.

nodes.label: Complete Public Payload Contract
nodes.rationale: Portfolio Full 1Y is 2,676,781 characters and 669,196 estimated tokens. Indicator history contributes 73.84%, events 21.54%, technical prices 2.86%, and indicator metadata without rows 1.62%; sharing metadata alone saves 0.82%. The best offline candidate—latest state, period summary, last five indicator buckets, and all events—saves 70.27%, but is not implemented. Truncation and segmentation require a future versioned contract decision.

nodes.label: Deterministic Drawdown Data Gate
nodes.rationale: asset.drawdown_recovery is removed from the public catalog until Risk supplies deterministic drawdown episodes. The earlier selected-period fallback remains a historical record, and reinstatement is gated on deterministic Risk data.
